description:
Find screens from other products that solve the same design problem as this one: same primary
pattern first, then shared tasks, states and components (rarer tags count more). At most two per
product; each says why it matched, and a dark-theme copy folds into its row as variants. Use it after one good reference, e.g. other empty project
lists or other pricing pages with a comparison table.

kind.description: Only return this kind of screen.

sameProduct.description: Also include screens from the same product.

screenId.description: Screen id from search_screens or get_product, e.g. linear-signup.

name: find_related_screens
title: Find related screens in other products
